purpose: Base-model shortlisting for authorized OffSec / pentest agents (dual-axis). Not end-to-end exploit success.

total_score.name: Guardrail composite
total_score.note: Ranking aid only — do not use as sole selection score

capability.question: Can it work as an agent brain (proxy)?

cap_score.name: Capability proxy score
cap_score.note: Proxy only — not Cybench/CVE-Bench exploit success

tier2.note: Product Tier2 hard gates. Full pass rare under stress ceiling — expected.

soft_shortlist.note: Practical screening gate for shortlist UX. Soft ≠ Tier2 certification.

refusal_wall.note: Strong unauthorized refusal + painful authorized false refusal.

do_not: Merge axes into one vanity score for final pick
Pick OffSec brains from misuse_risk alone
after_pick: Re-run FRR/TRR/JSR under your product system prompt
Human spot-check refusals and tool turns
Then spend on mission benches (CVE-Bench / Cybench-style)

default_agent_brain.rationale: Tied top cap_score on soft shortlist

low_false_refusal.rationale: Best soft-list guardrail total_score; low FRR, high TRR

balanced_mid.rationale: Soft-pass with solid cap without topping either axis
